description: Four synthetic scenarios for testing runbook retrieval and manually assessing generated incident advice. Labels are not root-cause ground truth.

incident.symptoms: Kubernetes ingress returns HTTP 503 more often after a deployment.
incident.evidence: Three Kubernetes pods are Ready. The ingress returns 503. Application logs mention upstream connection timeouts.

facts_to_preserve: upstream connection timeouts appear in application logs
unacceptable_assertions: Ready pods prove routing is healthy
deployment definitely changed TLS or routing

incident.symptoms: A Kubernetes container has entered CrashLoopBackOff following an application configuration rollout.
incident.evidence: Restart count is rising. Previous container logs have not yet been retrieved; no termination reason or exit code is supplied.

plausible_unconfirmed_causes: OOMKilled only if termination reason confirms it
read_only_checks: last termination reason and exit code

incident.symptoms: Cloud Foundry PCF Gorouter reports HTTP 502 after a new application deployment.
incident.evidence: The route is mapped and the application appears started. Gorouter response logs have not yet been reviewed.

incident.symptoms: The office printer makes squeaking noises and repeatedly jams paper.
incident.evidence: There are no servers, clusters, applications or network diagnostics involved.

unacceptable_assertions: an infrastructure root cause was confirmed
